conflicts.issue: Product page 10 mm crimp vs manual 7.5 mm
conflicts.ruling: Use the exact 2021 numbered grip guide value of 7.5 mm for the modeled crimp. Retain 10 mm as conflicting page copy.
Mounting and all grip diagrams establish the fixed front pose; sliding/removal is not evidence of additional canonical training rotations.

conflicts.issue: 40 mm jug vs 38.1 mm nominal thickness
conflicts.ruling: Retain both facts; use nominal body dimensions, and do not enlarge the board or claim a 40 mm calibrated jug surface.

limitations: Manual jug 40 mm and nominal thickness 38.1 mm cannot both be treated as identical section measurements; model keeps the published 38.1 mm body.
Rear cleat mating details not measured. Front crimp and thumb shoulder curvature estimated.
